utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Great, I’ve got Opal and Eli covered for the tools, and Noah’s waiting on Hana’s confirmation. Once the details are set, we’re ready to go.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I’ve got duct tape, a few screwdrivers, a flashlight, and sturdy gloves covered. I’m set on my end.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Perfect — we’re in good shape on tools, and Noah can jump in as soon as Hana confirms the details. I’ll keep everyone posted and ready to head to the tool sorting area.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I’ll bring the duct tape, zip ties, and spare screws for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it—I'll bring the duct tape, zip ties, and spare screws.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — I’ve got the repair drive kept on the calendar, and it’s great that Eli and Dane are both helping out. Eli’s bringing sturdy gloves, a screwdriver, and spare screws, so we should be set.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, good to know — I heard Gus can help too, and he can bring a ladder and a good drill if we need them.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’ll be there at 9:00 a.m. with sturdy gloves, a screwdriver, and a few spare screws. Glad Dane and Rey are covered too.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Perfect, Eli — see you at 9:00 a.m. with your gloves, screwdriver, and spare screws. I’ll be there too, and Jules will keep the volunteers lined up for tool sorting.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good, Opal. I’ll be there at 9:00 a.m. with my gloves, screwdriver, and spare screws.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’ll bring a screwdriver and some extra tape for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Perfect — I can help out too, and I’ll catch up with Noah if needed.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: As soon as the time’s set, I’ll spread the word for the repair drive. Mara’s keeping it on the calendar for now, so just let me know when it’s locked in.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Quinn. I’ll make sure Rey, Dane, and Mina’s pieces are covered when we lock it in.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect — once you lock the time, I’ll get the word out right away. Mara can keep it on the calendar until then.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Got it — I’m mapping the repair-drive spots now. We still need people for sorting donations and loading boxes.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I can ask around for a couple more hands for sorting and loading. It’s still pretty simple, so I’ll keep folks posted if anything else comes in.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Ira — that helps. If you hear back, please tell me so I can keep the repair-drive spots updated.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: We still need folks to sort donations and load boxes for the repair drive. Gus can bring tools, Vik’ll spread the word, and Oren said he’s willing to help too.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Looks good — Rey’s got the screwdriver and extra tape ready, and Dane’s helping too. Mara’s keeping the repair drive on the calendar, so we should be set.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh great, that sounds like we’re in good shape now. I’ll keep folks posted if we need any last-minute help.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Do we have the schedule and the repair location yet? Once I know that, I can help sort out what’s needed.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Not yet, but I’m checking on it now. Leo can help with the repair drive, and Mina and Rey already have some supplies covered.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks—please let me know as soon as you have the time and place. Once I have those, I can help figure out what else we still need.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — Mara’s got the calendar and Cleo’s on supplies, and I’m still keeping it simple while folks bring what they can spare. Dane can help too if needed.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, so Mara’s definitely got it on the calendar, right? And Dane’s bringing the drill and screwdrivers?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep, Mara’s got it on the calendar. I’m not sure about Dane’s drill and screwdrivers yet, but he can help out if needed.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll spread the word about the repair drive and remind everyone to chip in what they can. Dane can help out too, and even a little from folks goes a long way.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That’s great, thanks. I’ll keep coordinating the school-side list and make sure everyone knows what to bring.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll keep repeating the plan and make sure the repair drive gets around to everyone.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can bring my tools and lend a hand for the repair drive. If Tess still needs help sorting donations or loading boxes, I’m happy to pitch in there too.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: It’s still on my calendar, and Eli’s bringing sturdy gloves, a screwdriver, and spare screws. Dane’s helping out too, so we should be set.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, I’ve got the supplies list noted. If anything’s still missing, I’ll jot it down for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Cleo — that should cover it for now. If anything else comes up, I’ll keep the repair drive on my calendar and let you know.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, good — I heard Rey’s bringing a screwdriver and tape, and Gus mentioned gloves and spare screws too. Sounds like we’re getting pretty well set for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I’ll keep spreading the word about the repair drive and remind everyone to chip in where they can. And if it works, Ira can drop something off later too.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That sounds great — I’ll keep passing it along too. With Rey, Gus, and Opal covering the tools and supplies, we should be in decent shape.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, Leo’s got the tools, and Dane’s bringing a drill with a few screwdrivers. Uli’s helping too, so we should be in good shape.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, that sounds covered. I’ll keep it simple and keep gathering whatever folks can spare.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Bo — that should make things a lot easier. I’ll try not to forget the details this time.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Great — Eli’s set for 9:00 with the repair kit ready, and Opal’s bringing the gloves, screwdriver, and spare screws too. Once Hana confirms the details, Noah can jump in as well.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Perfect — I’ll keep the 9:00 start locked in and have the kit ready for Eli.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That sounds helpful — can you tell me the time and where the repairs will be? Once I know that, I can see what I can do.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m still waiting on the final time and place, but I’ll let you know as soon as I hear it. I’m bringing a screwdriver and extra tape for the drive.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks — please send the time and place as soon as you get them. I can help once I know the schedule and where we’re meeting.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oren’s happy to help, and Gus can bring tools too. We still need folks for sorting donations and loading boxes, and Vik’s going to spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So Mara’s got the repair drive covered and will check in with everyone, right?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Not quite — the repair drive is Sunday at the community center, and I’m helping get the word out. Cleo’s keeping the supplies list updated, and Quinn will send me the details.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Oh, got it — Sunday at the community center, and you’re helping spread the word, right?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds like everyone’s got a good piece of it covered. I’ll keep an ear out if anything else comes in for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Ira — just keep the updates coming if you hear about a ladder or drill. We’re set for 9:00 a.m. with the gloves, screwdriver, and spare screws.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Will do — I’ll let you know right away if I hear about a ladder or drill. Sounds like the rest is lined up well for 9:00.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: That sounds good — I’ll start by sorting the donated tools and seeing what still needs fixing. Mina’s duct tape, zip ties, and spare screws will help too.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I can help out too — I’ll bring the extension cords and take a quick look at the side gate latch.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Dane — your cords and the latch check will be a big help. I’ll keep sorting the tools and let Leo know he can jump in too.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Got it — the repair drive is at 9:00 a.m., and we still need people for sorting donations and loading boxes. I’ll map out the remaining spots and then confirm the details with Noah.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’ve got the details straight; I’m checking the remaining repair-drive spots now so I can confirm with Noah next.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I’m bringing duct tape, zip ties, and spare screws for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Great — I can lend a hand with tools too, and I’ll make sure to bring my sturdy gloves and screwdriver.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Good, we can use the extra screwdriver. Do you want me to coordinate the tape and screws, or are you set on your end?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect — I’ll get Rosa’s details over to you soon so you can add her to the supply list. She’s happy to help spread the word about the repair drive too.
